items.q: What's included in monthly support & maintenance?
items.a: 24/7 uptime monitoring, weekly plugin/CMS/security updates, daily encrypted backups, malware scans, HIPAA-aware form audits, Core Web Vitals monitoring, on-page SEO health checks, monthly reporting, and a fixed number of content/design edit hours based on your plan.

items.q: How fast do you respond to a site-down emergency?
items.a: Essential plan: under 4 hours. Growth plan: under 1 hour. Enterprise plan: under 15 minutes with a named on-call engineer. Every plan includes 24/7 automated monitoring so we usually know before you do.
Yes. We maintain BAA-ready hosting, audit contact/intake forms for PHI exposure, keep analytics PHI-free, and log every access. All engineers are trained on dermatology-specific compliance risks.

items.q: Do you support sites you didn't build?
items.a: Yes. We onboard existing WordPress, Webflow, custom, and headless dermatology sites after a paid technical audit — so we inherit them safely and know exactly what we're maintaining.
Yes — month-to-month, no long-term contracts. We earn your retainer every month. On offboarding you keep all code, credentials, backups, and documentation.

items.q: Do content and small design edits count?
items.a: Every plan includes edit hours (2 / 5 / unlimited). Use them for provider bios, new services, promo banners, before-and-after uploads, blog posts, or seasonal design tweaks.

cta_bottom.title: Stop worrying about your website. We'll worry about it for you.
cta_bottom.description: Free website health audit — a real engineer reviews performance, security, HIPAA posture, and SEO. Then we recommend the right plan (or none).
